integrationSeam.blocker: Production Ed25519 platform keys must be provisioned via an authenticated Key Management Service (AWS KMS / HashiCorp Vault / Cloud KMS) or offline ceremony managed by Person 3 (Backend/DevOps). No deployable production private key exists in this frontend repository. Fabricating production trust keys in source control is prohibited by VeraTrace cryptographic policy.

keyLifecycleRules.active: Current valid signing key for new dossiers (annual rotation).
keyLifecycleRules.deprecated: Previous annual key; remains valid for historical dossiers signed during its active window.
keyLifecycleRules.revoked: Compromised key; verifiers reject any manifest signed by this key regardless of export date.
